about: RQ-237 第 2 批:按产品阶段的打法库(plan.py 读)。每条打法只属于列出的阶段,plan.py 只从当前阶段里选,不跨阶段。字段:stages 适用阶段;theme 归哪条策略;dims 补哪一维成熟度(按 lifecycle 的最弱一格加权);base 本阶段内的基础优先级 1-5(base_by_stage 按阶段改写,比如需求验证在想法阶段 5、上线前 2);do / do_en 动作模板,{product} {main_line} {lines} {customers} {conversion} {competitor} {market} 从开局档案取,取不到用括号里的通用说法并标出缺哪条;page_types 动哪类页面;metric 预期动哪个数;measure 怎么量;week 最早第几周开始、weeks 持续几周、after 依赖哪几条;veto 任一条件成立就本轮出局(理由写进战略书);done_if 条件全部成立就当已做完、不再建议;tags 给禁用清单匹配用;ref 详细做法;cmd 首条命令。条件写法和 data/lifecycle.json 相同(key 来自 lifecycle 的证据表)。用户在 seo-ops/playbook/plays.json 里写 {"plays": [...]} 可以加自己的打法,同 id 覆盖内置的。

entity.name: 品牌实体与 AI 可见度

0: 核心词的联想词数量和问题词数量(demand_check.py),有关键词工具时看月搜索量
每个核心词前 10 名的站型分布
域名可注册、品牌名搜索时不被别的东西占满
1: launch 清单自动项通过数 / 总数,手动项有负责人
GSC、Bing 已验证,统计埋点能记到转化
2: GSC 已收录页数 / sitemap 页数
近 28 天展示和查询词数
3: GSC 非品牌点击,按产品线分
GA4 organic 的转化(开局第 1 环定的那个)
AI 引荐流量和引用面板命中率
4: 点击比去年同期跌 20% 以上的页数
刷新页 8 周后点击变化
5: 改动后 4 周点击 / 基线点击
旧 URL 有 301 的比例
改动后新出现的 404、链式跳转、canonical 错误数

plays.title: 用真实搜索数据验证需求
plays.title_en: Validate demand with real search data
plays.do: 把 {main_line} 的叫法和 {customers} 会搜的问题列成 10–30 个种子词,跑联想词和问题词,看有没有人搜、搜什么、结果里已经是谁;结论写成一页需求验证报告
plays.do_en: List 10-30 seed terms for {main_line} as {customers} would search them, expand autocomplete and question terms, check who already ranks; write a one-page demand report
plays.metric: 核心词的联想词和问题词数量;结果前 10 的站型分布
plays.measure: demand_check.py 的报告;有关键词工具时补月搜索量

plays.title: 起名和域名过一遍搜索可见度
plays.title_en: Check the name and domain for search visibility
plays.do: 给 {product} 的候选名字查:域名能不能注册、搜这个名字时联想和结果是不是已经被别的东西占满、和 {competitor} 会不会混淆
plays.do_en: For each candidate name for {product}: check the domain, whether autocomplete and results are already taken by something else, and whether it is confused with {competitor}
plays.metric: 可注册域名数;品牌名联想里被别的东西占的比例

plays.title: 按关键词版图定信息架构和 URL
plays.title_en: Set information architecture and URLs from the keyword map
plays.do: 把需求验证出来的词按意图归成主题簇,一簇对应一类页面;给 {lines} 定 URL 规则(层级、语言前缀、对比页 / 集成页 / 文档放哪),写成一张页面类型表
plays.do_en: Group validated terms into topic clusters, one cluster per page type; set URL rules for {lines} (depth, locale prefix, where compare / integration / docs pages live) as one page-type table
plays.metric: 每个主题簇都有对应的页面类型;URL 规则覆盖全部页面类型

plays.title: 技术选型先过 SEO 约束
plays.title_en: Check the tech stack against SEO constraints
plays.do: 选框架和托管前确认:关键页面能服务端渲染或静态生成、能按页设 title / meta / canonical、能出 sitemap 和 hreflang、{market} 之外的语言怎么放、改 URL 能做 301
plays.do_en: Before picking a framework and host, confirm: key pages render on the server or statically, per-page title / meta / canonical, sitemap and hreflang output, how languages beyond {market} are placed, 301 support
plays.metric: 约束清单 8 项全部有答案
plays.measure: stage-0 打法卡第四节的 8 项逐条打勾

plays.title: 品牌实体从第一天起统一
plays.title_en: Keep the brand entity consistent from day one
plays.do: 定一份品牌事实卡:{product} 的正式名、一句话简介、产品线 {lines}、目标客户 {customers};之后官网、社媒主页、目录站都照这一份写,先占好同名账号
plays.do_en: Write one brand fact card: official name of {product}, one-line description, product lines {lines}, target customers {customers}; use it for the site, social profiles and directories; reserve the same handle
plays.measure: grounding_page.py 生成事实页;各平台逐个核对

plays.title: 先定转化怎么记
plays.title_en: Decide how conversions are recorded
plays.do: 把「{conversion}」定成唯一的主转化,写清事件名、触发点、自然流量口径;上线前就埋好,不要上线后补
plays.do_en: Make '{conversion}' the single primary conversion; write the event name, trigger and organic definition; instrument it before launch
plays.metric: 主转化有事件名和口径

plays.title: 跑上线清单,每项写负责人
plays.title_en: Run the launch checklist with an owner per item
plays.do: 在 {product} 的本地预览或预发环境跑上线清单:robots、sitemap、canonical、hreflang、结构化数据、分享卡片、速度、404 和跳转,按 {lines} 的模板各抽一页;自动项脚本查,手动项写负责人和截止日
plays.do_en: Run the launch checklist on the {product} preview or staging: robots, sitemap, canonical, hreflang, structured data, share cards, speed, 404 and redirects, sampling one page per template of {lines}; scripts check automatic items, manual items get an owner and a due date
plays.metric: 清单自动项通过率 100%;手动项都有负责人

plays.title: 在本地预览上跑体检
plays.title_en: Audit the local preview
plays.do: 用 site_crawl --allow-local 爬本地预览,按 {lines} 的页面类型分组看问题;CRITICAL 清零才上线
plays.do_en: Crawl the local preview with site_crawl --allow-local and group issues by the page types of {lines}; launch only with zero CRITICAL
plays.measure: health_score.py 主分和 CRITICAL 数

plays.title: GSC、Bing 验证和转化埋点上线前就绪
plays.title_en: Have GSC, Bing and conversion tracking ready before launch
plays.do: 准备 GSC 和 Bing Webmaster 的域名验证(DNS 记录),埋好「{conversion}」事件并在预览上触发一次确认能记到
plays.do_en: Prepare GSC and Bing Webmaster domain verification (DNS), instrument the '{conversion}' event and fire it once on the preview
plays.metric: 转化事件在预览上能记到

plays.title: 定 AI 爬虫策略,准备 llms.txt
plays.title_en: Set the AI crawler policy and prepare llms.txt
plays.do: 按 {product} 想不想被 AI 引用定 robots 里各 AI 爬虫放不放;准备 llms.txt,按 {lines} 列核心页
plays.do_en: Decide per AI crawler in robots based on whether {product} wants AI citations; prepare llms.txt listing core pages for {lines}
plays.metric: AI 爬虫策略写明;llms.txt 覆盖每条产品线

plays.title: 上线时每条产品线至少一张能排名的核心页
plays.title_en: Launch with at least one rankable core page per product line
plays.do: {lines} 每条产品线一张核心页(产品页或落地页),标题对准需求验证出来的主词,写清给 {customers} 解决什么、怎么「{conversion}」
plays.do_en: One core page per product line in {lines}, title aimed at the validated head term, saying what it solves for {customers} and how to '{conversion}'
plays.metric: 每条产品线有核心页;content_score 过线

plays.title: 替换旧站时先做 301 映射表
plays.title_en: Map 301s first when replacing an old site
plays.do: 新站要替换已有的站时,上线前把旧站全部 URL 和 GSC 有点击的页导出来,逐条映射到新 URL,存一份基线
plays.do_en: If the new site replaces an existing one, export all old URLs and pages with GSC clicks before launch, map each to a new URL and save a baseline
plays.metric: 有点击的旧 URL 100% 有映射

plays.title: 起草收录提交:GSC、Bing、IndexNow
plays.title_en: Draft index submissions: GSC, Bing, IndexNow
plays.do: 起草 sitemap 提交和 IndexNow 推送(用户自己点提交),先推 {lines} 的核心页;两周后看收录率
plays.do_en: Draft the sitemap submission and IndexNow push (the user clicks submit), core pages for {lines} first; check the index rate after two weeks

plays.title: 冷启动外链:目录、上架平台、社区、合作页
plays.title_en: Cold-start links: directories, launch platforms, communities, partner pages
plays.do: 列 {customers} 常去的目录、产品上架平台和社区,以及和 {product} 有集成或合作的公司页面,逐个起草提交或外联稿(用户自己发)
plays.do_en: List directories, launch platforms and communities {customers} use, plus partner and integration pages, and draft each submission or outreach note (the user sends)
page_types: 站外:目录、上架平台、合作页

plays.title: 建品牌实体档案:sameAs、各平台主页
plays.title_en: Build the brand entity: sameAs and platform profiles
plays.do: 在首页 Organization 结构化数据里写全 sameAs,把 {product} 的各平台主页名称和简介统一成品牌事实卡;符合收录条件再考虑 Wikidata
plays.do_en: Complete sameAs in the homepage Organization markup and align every profile of {product} to the brand fact card; consider Wikidata only if it qualifies
plays.metric: sameAs 数量;品牌词搜索结果第一页是自己的页数

plays.title: 第一批核心内容:每条产品线 3–5 篇
plays.title_en: First core content: 3-5 pieces per product line
plays.do: 按需求验证的问题词,给 {main_line} 先写 3–5 篇回答 {customers} 买之前常问的问题的内容,每篇链回产品页、导向「{conversion}」
plays.do_en: From validated question terms, write 3-5 pieces for {main_line} answering what {customers} ask before buying, each linking to the product page and leading to '{conversion}'

plays.title: 让 AI 读得到:llms.txt 和事实一致
plays.title_en: Be readable by AI: llms.txt and consistent facts
plays.do: 上线 llms.txt,按 {lines} 列核心页;核对官网、文档、社媒上 {product} 的名称和简介一致
plays.do_en: Publish llms.txt listing core pages for {lines}; check that the name and description of {product} match across site, docs and social
plays.metric: AI 引荐流量开始出现

plays.title: 接 GSC,存第一份基线
plays.title_en: Connect GSC and save the first baseline
plays.do: 接上 GSC(服务账号或导出),存第一份 28 天基线:展示、点击、查询词数、品牌词和非品牌词分开;之后每周运营单和它比
plays.do_en: Connect GSC (service account or export) and save a first 28-day baseline: impressions, clicks, query count, brand vs non-brand; weekly ops compares to it

plays.title: 先修 {product} 的体检 CRITICAL
plays.title_en: Fix audit CRITICALs on {product} first
plays.do: 先跑体检(没跑过的话);把 CRITICAL(不可达、误封 noindex、robots 误拒、canonical 断链)按 {lines} 的页面类型分组修,修完复测。体检查到 CRITICAL 时这条自动排第一
plays.do_en: Run the audit if it has not run; fix CRITICALs (unreachable, wrong noindex, robots blocks, broken canonical) grouped by the page types of {lines}, then re-test. Ranks first automatically when the audit finds CRITICALs

plays.title: 按产品线扩关键词版图和主题簇
plays.title_en: Expand the keyword map and topic clusters per product line
plays.do: 从 GSC 拉 {main_line} 有展示没点击、排名 8–20 的词,按意图归成主题簇,每簇定一张支柱页和 3–6 张支撑页
plays.do_en: Pull GSC terms for {main_line} with impressions but few clicks at positions 8-20, group by intent into clusters, one pillar plus 3-6 supporting pages each
plays.measure: GSC 按页面组过滤,8 周

plays.title: 对比页和替代页
plays.title_en: Comparison and alternative pages
plays.do: 给 {main_line} 做「{product} vs {competitor}」和「{competitor} 替代」页,事实只写能核对的,写清适合 {customers} 的哪种情况
plays.do_en: Build '{product} vs {competitor}' and '{competitor} alternative' pages for {main_line}; only verifiable facts; say which {customers} situation each fits
plays.metric: 对比页的非品牌点击和「{conversion}」

veto.why: 第 3 环说过对外不能点名别的公司

plays.title: 内容生产线:brief → 写 → 评分 → 发
plays.title_en: Content line: brief, write, score, publish
plays.do: 按主题簇排 {main_line} 的内容队列,每篇先出 brief(意图、要回答 {customers} 的哪些问题、链到哪张产品页),过 content_score 再发
plays.do_en: Queue {main_line} content by cluster; each piece starts with a brief (intent, which {customers} questions it answers, which product page it links to) and passes content_score before publishing
plays.metric: 每月发布篇数;新文 8 周点击

plays.title: 程序化页面试点(过闸门)
plays.title_en: Programmatic pages pilot (gated)
plays.do: {lines} 里有「X 对 Y」「X 用在 Z」这类模式词的,用真实数据做 50–100 页试点,过质量闸门再放量
plays.do_en: Where {lines} have pattern terms ('X for Y', 'X with Z'), pilot 50-100 pages from real data, scale only after the quality gate passes

veto.why: 站太小,先把核心页和内容做起来

plays.title: 内链:孤儿页和支柱页
plays.title_en: Internal links: orphans and pillars
plays.do: 跑链接图,把 {main_line} 的孤儿页接进支柱页,把权重高的页链到「{conversion}」相关的产品页
plays.do_en: Run the link graph, connect {main_line} orphans to pillars, link high-weight pages to the product pages that lead to '{conversion}'
plays.metric: 孤儿页数;产品页入链数

veto.why: 页面不到 100,内链收益有限

plays.title: 外链与合作:谁链了 {competitor} 没链我们
plays.title_en: Links and partnerships: who links to {competitor} but not us
plays.do: 用 link_intel 找链了 {competitor} 却没链 {product} 的站和合作页,按 {customers} 的相关度排,起草外联(用户自己发)
plays.do_en: Use link_intel to find sites and partner pages linking to {competitor} but not {product}, rank by relevance to {customers}, draft outreach (the user sends)

plays.title: AI 引用监控:{customers} 会问的问题
plays.title_en: AI citation monitoring for questions {customers} ask
plays.do: 把 {customers} 买 {main_line} 之前会问 AI 的 10–30 个问题做成引用面板,每周看 {product} 和 {competitor} 谁被引用
plays.do_en: Turn 10-30 questions {customers} ask AI before buying {main_line} into a citation panel; weekly, see whether {product} or {competitor} is cited
plays.metric: 引用面板命中率;AI 引荐流量

plays.title: 自然流量到「{conversion}」的归因
plays.title_en: Attribute organic traffic to '{conversion}'
plays.do: 把「{conversion}」按首次落地页和渠道归到页面类,每周运营单按带来转化的页类排优先级
plays.do_en: Attribute '{conversion}' by first landing page and channel to page classes; weekly ops ranks by the classes that bring conversions
plays.metric: 每个页面类的自然转化
plays.measure: ga4_api.py;ops.py 的 conversions 数据包

plays.title: 开每周运营单
plays.title_en: Start the weekly ops sheet
plays.do: 每周跑一次 {product} 的运营单:硬告警、本周路线项、只做这一件;连续 4 期,每期看 {main_line} 的数
plays.do_en: Run the weekly ops sheet for {product}: hard alerts, this week's roadmap item, the single pick; four weeks in a row, watching {main_line}

plays.title: 下一个市场:{main_line} 先做
plays.title_en: Next market, starting with {main_line}
plays.do: {market} 之外有量的市场里,先把 {main_line} 的核心页做本地化(不是机翻),hreflang 成簇再扩
plays.do_en: In markets beyond {market} that show demand, localize the {main_line} core pages first (not machine translation); expand once hreflang clusters are clean

plays.title: 刷新衰退页
plays.title_en: Refresh decaying pages
plays.do: 用 GSC 双期找 {main_line} 点击比去年跌 20% 以上的页,先刷新带来过「{conversion}」的那些
plays.do_en: Use two GSC periods to find {main_line} pages down 20%+ year over year; refresh the ones that brought '{conversion}' first

plays.title: 退役:零点击、零入链、零外链的页
plays.title_en: Prune pages with zero clicks, internal links and backlinks
plays.do: 三查都为零的页合并、301 或 noindex;{lines} 的核心页和带来过「{conversion}」的页类不动
plays.do_en: Merge, 301 or noindex pages that are zero on all three checks; never touch core pages of {lines} or page classes that brought '{conversion}'
plays.metric: 退役页数;站点平均点击 / 页

plays.title: 掉量查根因:算法、技术、竞品
plays.title_en: Find the cause of the decline: algorithm, technical, competitor
plays.do: 对 {main_line} 的掉量跑 monitor diff → 波动传感器 → 改动日志,分清是算法更新、自己改坏了,还是 {competitor} 抢了位置
plays.do_en: For the {main_line} decline run monitor diff, the volatility sensor and the change log to separate algorithm updates, self-inflicted changes, and {competitor} taking positions

plays.title: SEO 实验:标题和模板分组测
plays.title_en: SEO experiments: test titles and templates in groups
plays.do: {main_line} 同类页够多时,按组改标题或模板做分组实验,用对照组判效果,不凭感觉全站改
plays.do_en: When {main_line} has enough similar pages, test titles or templates by group against a control instead of changing everything

veto.why: 同类页不够多,实验分不出组

plays.title: 找回丢掉的外链和未链提及
plays.title_en: Reclaim lost links and unlinked mentions
plays.do: 导出近半年丢掉的引用域和提到 {product} 却没链的页,起草找回邮件(用户自己发)
plays.do_en: Export referring domains lost in six months and pages mentioning {product} without a link; draft reclaim notes (the user sends)

plays.title: 改动前存基线
plays.title_en: Save a baseline before the change
plays.do: 改动前存一份基线:全部 URL、状态码、canonical、hreflang、title,GSC 近 28 天按页点击;{lines} 的核心页单独列
plays.do_en: Before the change, save a baseline: all URLs, status, canonical, hreflang, titles and 28-day GSC clicks by page; list core pages of {lines} separately

plays.title: 301 映射表:有点击的旧 URL 全覆盖
plays.title_en: 301 map covering every old URL with clicks
plays.do: 旧 URL 逐条映射到新 URL,一跳到位;有点击的页 100% 覆盖,canonical 和 hreflang 指向新址
plays.do_en: Map each old URL to a new one in a single hop; cover 100% of pages with clicks; canonical and hreflang point to the new URLs

plays.title: 改动后和基线对比
plays.title_en: Compare against the baseline after the change
plays.do: 上线当天和之后 4 周和基线比:新出现的 404、链式跳转、canonical 指向旧址、hreflang 断簇;{lines} 的核心页点击保留率
plays.do_en: On launch day and for four weeks, compare to the baseline: new 404s, redirect chains, canonicals to old URLs, broken hreflang clusters; click retention of core pages for {lines}
plays.metric: 4 周点击保留率;新错误数

plays.title: 新产品线回开局第 1 环
plays.title_en: Take the new product line back to onboarding ring 1
plays.do: 新加的产品线(不是 {main_line})回到开局第 1 环,只问新的那部分:卖给谁、转化算什么、和谁抢
plays.do_en: Take the new product line (not {main_line}) back to onboarding ring 1 and ask only about it: who buys, what counts as conversion, who competes

plays.title: 看清搜索结果里赢的是哪类页
plays.title_en: See which page types win the results
plays.do: 对需求验证里信号强的 5–10 个词,看前 10 名是产品页、榜单、论坛还是视频,以及 {competitor} 在不在;赢的页型决定 {main_line} 先做哪类页
plays.do_en: For the 5-10 strongest terms, check whether the top 10 are product pages, listicles, forums or videos and whether {competitor} is there; the winning page type decides what {main_line} builds first
plays.metric: 每个核心词的赢家页型
plays.measure: serp_occupancy.py(有 SERP 导出时)或人工看前 10

plays.title: 定上线时的前 10 张页
plays.title_en: Choose the first 10 pages for launch
plays.do: 从主题簇里挑 10 张上线就要有的页:{main_line} 的产品页、定价、1–2 张对比 {competitor} 的页、回答 {customers} 最常问问题的几篇,写好每张的目标词
plays.do_en: Pick 10 pages needed at launch: the {main_line} product page, pricing, 1-2 pages comparing with {competitor}, and pieces answering what {customers} ask most, each with a target term
plays.metric: 10 张页都有目标词和意图

plays.title: 问一遍 AI:{customers} 的问题现在谁被引用
plays.title_en: Ask AI assistants what {customers} ask, and who gets cited
plays.do: 把 {customers} 选 {main_line} 时会问的 10 个问题拿去问主流 AI 助手,记下被引用的站和 {competitor} 的出现次数,作为 GEO 的起点
plays.do_en: Ask mainstream AI assistants 10 questions {customers} ask when choosing {main_line}; record cited sites and how often {competitor} appears as the GEO starting point
plays.metric: 10 个问题里被引用的站和次数

plays.title: 看 {competitor} 靠哪类页拿流量和外链
plays.title_en: See which pages bring {competitor} traffic and links
plays.do: 用 link_intel 看 {competitor} 被谁链、哪类页拿到外链和排名,找 {main_line} 能补的空档
plays.do_en: Use link_intel to see who links to {competitor} and which page types earn links and rankings; find gaps {main_line} can fill

plays.title: 先放一张可收录的落地页
plays.title_en: Publish one indexable landing page early
plays.do: 产品还没做完时先在正式域名放一张 {product} 落地页(说清给 {customers} 解决什么,收「{conversion}」意向),让域名和品牌名先被收录
plays.do_en: Before the product is done, publish one {product} landing page on the real domain (what it solves for {customers}, collecting '{conversion}' interest) so the domain and brand get indexed early

plays.title: 产品和组织的结构化数据
plays.title_en: Product and organization structured data
plays.do: 首页放 Organization(含 sameAs),{main_line} 的产品页放 SoftwareApplication 或 Product,价格和名称与定价页一致
plays.do_en: Add Organization (with sameAs) on the homepage and SoftwareApplication or Product on the {main_line} page, with name and price matching the pricing page

plays.title: 备好上线当天的收录和冷启动包
plays.title_en: Prepare the launch-day indexing and cold-start pack
plays.do: 上线前起草好:sitemap 提交、IndexNow 推送清单、{customers} 常去的目录和产品上架平台的提交稿(用户自己点提交)
plays.do_en: Before launch, draft the sitemap submission, the IndexNow list and listings for directories and launch platforms {customers} use (the user submits)

plays.title: 存一份上线当天的基线
plays.title_en: Save a launch-day baseline
plays.do: 上线当天存 {product} 的全部 URL、状态码、canonical、title,之后每周运营单和它比,出问题能查到是哪天改的
plays.do_en: On launch day save all {product} URLs, status, canonical and titles; weekly ops compares to it so regressions can be dated

plays.title: 查没收录的原因
plays.title_en: Find why pages are not indexed
plays.do: 两周后看 GSC 页面报告里没收录的 {main_line} 页,按原因(已发现未编入、已抓取未编入、重复)分组处理
plays.do_en: After two weeks, group unindexed {main_line} pages in the GSC page report by reason (discovered, crawled not indexed, duplicate) and fix each group

plays.title: 搜 {product} 时第一页都是自己的
plays.title_en: Own page one for the {product} name
plays.do: 搜品牌名时第一页应是官网、文档、各平台主页;被别的同名东西占了就补主页和事实页
plays.do_en: Searching the brand should show the site, docs and official profiles on page one; if a namesake takes it, add profiles and a fact page
plays.metric: 品牌词第一页自己的结果数

plays.title: 新版本上线前在预发上跑上线清单
plays.title_en: Run the launch checklist on the new version's staging
plays.do: 新版本在预发上跑 launch_check 和体检:canonical 指向新正式域名、robots 没封、{lines} 每个模板抽一页
plays.do_en: Run launch_check and an audit on the new version's staging: canonical to the new production domain, robots open, one page per {lines} template

plays.title: 站内信号跟着换:内链、sitemap、hreflang
plays.title_en: Move on-site signals: internal links, sitemap, hreflang
plays.do: 内链直接指新 URL(不靠 301)、sitemap 只列新 URL、hreflang 成簇;换域名时在 GSC 提交地址变更
plays.do_en: Point internal links straight at new URLs (not via 301), list only new URLs in the sitemap, keep hreflang clusters; file a GSC change of address for a domain move
plays.metric: 内链指向 301 的数量为 0

plays.title: 请最重要的外链改指新地址
plays.title_en: Ask the most valuable linking sites to update URLs
plays.do: 导出指向 {product} 旧 URL 的前 20 个引用域,起草改链请求(用户自己发)
plays.do_en: Export the top 20 referring domains linking to old {product} URLs and draft link update requests (the user sends)
plays.metric: 改指新地址的引用域数

plays.title: 改动后 4 周每天看告警
plays.title_en: Daily alerts for four weeks after the change
plays.do: 改动后 4 周每天跑 monitor:{main_line} 核心页点击掉 30% 以上、新 404、收录骤降就告警
plays.do_en: For four weeks after the change, run monitor daily: alert on 30%+ click drops on {main_line} core pages, new 404s or index drops

plays.title: 改版不丢有点击的内容
plays.title_en: Keep content that earns clicks through the redesign
plays.do: 基线里有点击的 {main_line} 页,新版本的标题、正文要点、结构化数据不删;要删的先列出来给用户确认
plays.do_en: For {main_line} pages with clicks in the baseline, keep titles, key content and structured data in the new version; list anything to remove for the user to confirm
plays.metric: 有点击页的内容保留率
